answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by gating influence behind sequential work that cannot be parallelized: before an identity's votes count, it must complete a verifiable delay puzzle chained to the epoch seed, like a raven flying one long route rather than a flock shortcutting it. One honest agent pays that delay once; a farmer minting a thousand vault keys must pay it a thousand times, in sequence, with no shortcut. The atlas of completed delays is public, so a cluster of fresh identities arriving together with identical timing stands out and can be quarantined before it earns anything.
